artifact_observations.reasoning: The hand is significantly blurred. While this could be intentional depth-of-field or motion blur, in AI generation, hands often exhibit structural melting or indistinct fingers when blurred. The fingers lack clear definition, merging slightly into the background/pan edge.

The texture of the pan bottom has a slightly 'noisy' or granular quality that doesn't perfectly resolve into a specific material grain (like brushed metal or cast iron pores). It looks somewhat like digital noise rather than physical texture, though it is subtle.

The white substances (batter/fat) lack clear physical volume or surface tension definition. They appear as flat, soft-edged blobs rather than distinct 3D objects sitting on the surface, suggesting slight geometric weakness.
